name: Winged Heritor
body:
Your wings reflect the soaring saurian of your ancient ancestors.

Prerequisite(s): Str 13, Skill Focus (Fly), zvarr, stretched wings racial trait.

Benefit(s): Your racial fly speed increases to 40 feet (average maneuverability), and you no longer need to make Fly checks to fly upward.
